snippet.title: ALL WILL FALL - Launch Trailer | Out Now on Steam | Physics-Based Survival City Builder
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706020/ALL_WILL_FALL_PhysicsBased_Survival_City_Builder

ALL WILL FALL is out now on Steam!

🏗️ BUILD massive ocean cities using a physics-based construction system
📝 MANAGE your colony, resources, and production to ensure survival
⚖️ DECIDE the future of your settlement by making tough political decisions
